statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-33997 is a privilege-validation bypass in the Moby daemon's plugin installation; promxy links no plugin manager or daemon and never calls the client's plugin endpoints. The fix (29.3.1) exists only under the github.com/moby/moby module path, so the +incompatible module cannot be floated to it. Verified for promxy v0.0.97: the upstream release binary contains 0 Go symbol names under docker/docker or moby/moby daemon, plugin or api/server (grep -c on the binary), while docker/docker/client and api/types symbols are present, so the search sees the module. Promxy reaches the module only through Prometheus' Docker service discovery, a client. The recipe runs go list -deps ./cmd/promxy and a daemon-path grep on every build output and fails the build if either finds daemon code.

CVE-2026-41567 is in the Moby/Docker daemon: a malicious image making the daemon run its own decompression binary on PUT /containers/{id}/archive. No fix exists on either module path (only moby/moby/v2 2.0.0-beta.14). The image runs no dockerd. Verified for promxy v0.0.97: the upstream release binary contains 0 Go symbol names under docker/docker or moby/moby daemon, plugin or api/server (grep -c on the binary), while docker/docker/client and api/types symbols are present, so the search sees the module. Promxy reaches the module only through Prometheus' Docker service discovery, a client. The recipe runs go list -deps ./cmd/promxy and a daemon-path grep on every build output and fails the build if either finds daemon code.
